_comment: Machine-checkable claim/premise dependency graph for the q0 program. Statuses are transcribed from the sources named in each `source` field as of 2026-09-17; this file asserts no mathematics of its own. tools/claims_check.py enforces the invariants documented in claims/README.md.

OBL-D1-PROMOTE.note: Chart side open. Normalizer sub-part discharged by the H3 band floor.

D3-LEMMA-RN-UNIF.note: Piece 1 OPEN; Piece 2 OPEN (annulus Riemann-sum driver unwritten). Receipts carry lemma_closed: false. CL-RNU-001/002/003 are PROPOSED with authority none.

Wrap/remote reconciliation under D1 remains open. Frozen v2.2 still names the premise until next issuance.

H5-AXIS.note: Named hypothesis of the certified rung, not discharged.

H-B3.note: Cell-sup premise carried by the W8 v3 Lambda conditional estimate.

D1-v2.3-DRAFT(2).note: DRAFT / PROPOSED. Not operator-promoted over frozen v2.2; PKG-01 ships v2.2.

H3-BAND-FLOOR.note: Discharges the normalizer sub-part of OBL-D1-PROMOTE. Frozen body 281477c3.

RN5-NEAR-POINT-CERTS.statement: 65 point-law certificates on the 13-radius, 5-angle D4 net plus 10 spatial-box certificates for the corrected near-region moment bound, at 384 bits.
RN5-NEAR-POINT-CERTS.note: Ten boxes do NOT cover the annulus. Diagnostic polar sums (2.34195 r^3 corrected, 17.67237 r^3 wrong-power) are not bounds on the spatial integral.

LPW-QUALITATIVE.statement: 2D side-24 exact six-pin typed pair-Palm elder pairing: there exist c, r0 > 0 with 1 - q >= c * r^3.
LPW-QUALITATIVE.note: 37/37 payload hashes match; whole verdict hash matches; body-rule separator amendment needed. One external provider family; branch count is not independent-family count.

QC-RETURN03-FALLBACK.note: Preserved as a separate fallback. New defects in the improved constant do not consume or refute this.

LPW-CONSTANT-DELIVERED.note: Reported headline 6.239e-44 exceeds the exact chain; the E(|xi|+|eta|)^4 = 12 + 16/pi identity is false; blanket-rounding explanation incomplete. Do not admit the delivered certificate unqualified.

MATCHING-2D-UPPER.note: Investigation authorized. 2D two-sided Theta NOT admitted. No combination with the 3D upper.

K3-THM-001.note: NONCONTROLLING, retained as provenance. No rehabilitation without an exact new identity and every consumed weighted-law / Bonferroni / exit premise.

PR-TAL-003..008.note: 'Sealed' is archive-custody language, not theorem grade.

P15-A..D.statement: Structural localization: critical-threshold crosswalk, palette-separated localization, connected unbounded-width family, complete-transversal graph composition.
P15-A..D.note: No proof that every downset has a bounded palette-localization certificate, a suitable complete-transversal representation, or bounded scalar width. No q0 uniformity obligation is discharged.

firewalls.rule: No claim may depend, transitively, on objects from both the UPPER2D/LOWER2D tracks and the LIFETIME3D track.

firewalls.rule: No UPPER2D/LOWER2D/LIFETIME3D claim may depend on a NUMBER_THEORY claim, and vice versa.
A claim graded LIVE_ROOT_THEOREM, FROZEN_CERTIFICATE or RATIFIED_3D_ONLY may not depend on any premise whose frozen status is OPEN or NOT_CLOSED.
Every NUMBER_THEORY claim must carry original_prize_closed: false.
Q0-C101-QUALITATIVE-RATE must forbid any finite decimal for C_Q0, and Q0-C104-THEOREM-B any numerical C*.
